title: Find a job in the NSW public sector
summary: This page directs you to the 'I work for NSW' website to search for job opportunities within the NSW public sector.
intro:
You can search for NSW public sector jobs online at the 'I work for NSW' website.

The website also includes information about:

You can search for jobs by keywords, or reference ID. You can browse available jobs by category, portfolio and location.

To get started, go to the I work for NSW website.
what_you_need: Access to the I work for NSW website
